All Levels: Show & Go

Peoria, AZ · Road

All Levels: Show & Go is a road group ride in Peoria, AZ. It rolls every Friday at 7:00 am from SouthWest Bicycles, in the back lot.

How we know

The club's RideWithGPS calendar lists All Levels: Show & Go on most Fridays since June, including Sept 25 and Oct 2, 2026 at 7:00 am. The Oct 2 event page puts the start at SouthWest Bicycles, 19027 N 83rd Ave #2, Peoria, in the back lot (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

For visitors

First-time guests can ride once and are covered by the club's insurance. Non-members sign a waiver each time. After one guest ride you must join the club. A helmet is required. The ride leader posts each week's details on the club's RideWithGPS calendar.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all levels. The leader says you show up and the group works out where to go, and the posted routes are just a suggestion. The club's ride key says all rides are no-drop.. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the All Levels: Show & Go group ride

The SouthWest Bicycles Cycling Club's Friday morning road ride for every level, out of the shop's back lot in Peoria. There is no fixed route. The leader says you show up and the group works out where to go, and the posted routes are only a suggestion. The club says all its rides are no-drop.
